purpose: First canonical Stage A implementation for Neumorphism and Retro Mac across the nine Inbox/Triage recipes.

resultingCommits.message: feat(triage): conform inbox themes and accessibility

knownFindingsBeforeImplementation: Shell and section chrome had correct placement/background but materially weak framing, depth, dividers, header identity, and theme grammar.
Scratch Pool semantics existed while row, tool, inset/raised, and Finder-style treatments were flattened.
Selected Scratch Context preserved canonical Edit/Save/Cancel and Saved behavior but lacked theme-native depth, signature treatment, and action hierarchy.
Breakdown rows preserved Add/actions/status while row objects, grips, Add composition, empty/completion grammar, and depth needed conformance.
Staging preserved Node/Bit semantics but required themed chrome, wells, quiet-empty treatment, and invalid/drop-back roles without redesigning card internals.
Grid Explorer preserved four columns/path/search but had flat column, path, target, and status styling; Retro Mac native evidence did not prove populated Level 3.
Placement behavior remained canonical but required target/status, non-color, focus, and reduced-motion styling without occluding cards.
Newly/Undo semantics were canonical; Task 164 could style only the marker, rail, and action envelope while common card internals remained deferred.
Archive/completion semantics were authoritative from accepted evidence and needed theme role bindings plus static/reduced-motion styling without behavior changes.
expectedResult: Theme-native Neumorphism depth and Retro Mac 1-bit chrome while retaining canonical Save/Cancel, Add status, non-occluding Placement, Level 3 Explorer, Newly/Undo, and Archive behavior.

findings: Fixture retained state created by earlier manual browser interactions.
The first reduced-motion metric treated Chrome's 10 microsecond clamp as effective motion.

runs.differenceFromPreceding: Added Escape-interruption captures, recognized the actual idle-invalid state, and corrected reduced-motion interpretation; fixture contamination and dev overlay remained.
findings: Actual incompatible DnD state is idle-invalid and required a matching theme selector.
Development overlay was not acceptable final evidence.

runs.differenceFromPreceding: Cleared all non-system fixture data and moved capture to the production server; stopped before Archive evidence when raw IndexedDB mutation did not notify a mounted Dexie liveQuery.
findings: 29 images are preserved but are not a complete passing set.
Archive transition harness required a reload and canonical Reopen action.

runs.differenceFromPreceding: Production-server run resolved fixture isolation and Archive live-query handling, but its extended interaction matrix was not yet complete across all eight theme/mode/viewport combinations.
runs.actualVisibleResult: Theme grammar and canonical controls were visible without a development overlay; this run is retained as an intermediate measurement rather than final Stage A evidence.
runs.automatedBrowserResult: 68 screenshots and four comparison sheets passed at the then-current matrix breadth.

runs.differenceFromPreceding: Expanded the interaction matrix to 1024, then stopped after Edit was attempted while staged-Placement cancellation was still locked.
findings: Eight screenshots are preserved; the apparent editor frame did not contain Save/Cancel and is not passing evidence.

runs.differenceFromPreceding: Added operation-settlement and disabled-control checks, but a generic inline-editor selector still matched an unrelated field.
findings: Eight screenshots are preserved; editor identity required a Selected Scratch Context-scoped selector.

runs.differenceFromPreceding: Scoped Edit to Selected Scratch Context and captured Newly-before, then stopped when direct Placement type selection raced DnD release settlement.
findings: Fourteen screenshots are preserved; the missing Confirm state is not passing evidence.

runs.differenceFromPreceding: Waited for Placement release settlement and completed ordinary/reduced-motion captures, then stopped on a documentElement replacement race during the touch-audit reload.
findings: Twenty screenshots are preserved; the incomplete touch phase is not passing evidence.

runs.differenceFromPreceding: Stabilized each new production document and completed every extended interaction and dynamic touch scenario in all eight combinations; ordinary DnD reached active state but recorded only one token position.
runs.actualVisibleResult: Neumorphism uses raised section surfaces, inset wells, rounded depth, and soft relief. Retro Mac uses square 1-bit frames, striped headers, dithered invalid/empty regions, and hard shadows. Canonical Edit/Save/Cancel, Add status, Level 3, direct/staged non-occluding Placement, Newly/Undo, and Archive states remain visible. Direct inspection found no material mismatch hidden by automation.
runs.automatedBrowserResult: 200 screenshots and 40 interaction records: 25 screenshots in each of eight combinations; recipes 1-9; physical hover and keyboard focus-visible; ordinary DnD, eligible/idle-invalid/active-drop and Escape interruption; dirty Edit-cancel restoration; Add, Newly before/active/after, Archive, effective reduced motion; and five dynamic coarse-pointer scenarios with 128 sampled interactive instances and zero sub-44px failures per combination.

runs.differenceFromPreceding: Retained the complete run-09 matrix and added two-point drag-token and pointer samples with a hard failure below 10px movement for every valid DnD scenario.
runs.actualVisibleResult: The run-10 images reproduce the inspected run-09 theme result and canonical control geometry. Ordinary pointer DnD visibly moves the drag token before reaching the active target in every combination.
runs.automatedBrowserResult: 200 screenshots and 40 interaction records across all eight combinations. Eight ordinary-motion measurements record drag-token distances from 400.18px to 1020.80px; all eight idle-invalid states and all eight Escape interruption restorations pass. Five dynamic touch scenarios per combination retain zero sub-44px failures.

browserAndUserVisibleResult.visibleDisposition: The checkpoint implementer inspection judged the result consistent, but the post-checkpoint user review rejected actual Neumorphism and Retro Mac visual fidelity. The user disposition controls.

postCheckpointUserReview.scope: Functional, accessibility, and state-preservation results acknowledged; Neumorphism and Retro Mac visual fidelity rejected.
postCheckpointUserReview.experimentIdentity: T164-CA-I01 is preserved as the second implementation experiment and remains distinct from T164-NC-I01.
improvementsAcknowledged: The first experiment findings were made explicit starting inputs.
Save/Cancel, attached Add status, non-occluding Placement, Level 3, and Newly/Undo preservation decisions became explicit.
CSS and selected component-local visual-role bindings expanded.
Light/dark, 1024/1920, hover, focus, DnD, Placement, Edit, Add, Newly/Undo, and Archive evidence expanded.
Fixture isolation, production-build capture, touch-target checks, and reduced-motion checks improved.
704 artifacts and append-only run history were durably preserved.

failedFindings.finding: Known surface gaps were not converted into concrete element-to-element implementation obligations.
Implementation remained weighted toward global theme CSS over the existing generic component tree.
Core composition owners such as triage-workspace.tsx, scratch-pool.tsx, and breakdown-panel.tsx did not change.
Prototype and production comparisons did not match data, state, and viewport.
Direct prototype-to-production evidence was effectively limited to four light/base-centered comparison sheets.
The 200 PNG and interaction measurements proved coverage, function, and accessibility, not prototype fidelity.
Direct-render tests checked semantic attributes and state presence, not computed visual similarity.
The report conclusion that no material difference was hidden by automation contradicted the user's actual-screen review and comparison images.
Automated verification and implementer self-review were allowed to stand in for user-owned visual acceptance.

neumorphism.gap: Soft shadow exists, but raised-panel hierarchy and circular section identity are insufficient.
Raised rows, inset search, count capsule, segmented ASC/DESC, and circular controls are not reproduced.
Source/status marker, circular Edit/action hierarchy, and sufficient inset depth are missing.
Raised row objects, circular grip/actions, and circular Add composition are insufficient.
Inset wells and raised Node/compact Bit composition are insufficient.
Large square Node cards and generic columns remain instead of the prototype's compact soft-row hierarchy.
Targets and actions resemble generic bordered regions/forms more than theme-native inset/raised composition.
Presentation resembles a generic badge/status rail rather than the colored marker/capsule and integrated raised Undo.
This is the closest surface, but theme-specific archive/check identity and resolved context remain weak.

retroMac.gap: Stripes and hard borders exist, but nested Mac windows, title bands, and pane hierarchy are insufficient.
Selected-row text visibility is defective; FIND/list header, OLD FIRST, and window hierarchy are not reproduced.
File-properties window, title strip, folder/reference block, and metadata composition are missing.
A wide generic list remains instead of compact 1-bit row controls.
Large empty panes and generic cards remain instead of Finder folder/document grammar.
Modern square/cube cards remain instead of compact Finder rows.
Dithered target, system-dialog, and marquee grammar are insufficient.
The state is a separate generic status block rather than being integrated into the Finder row.
Double-border system alert and completed-file presentation are insufficient.

intentionalProductionDifferences: Retro Mac prototype-only faux global menu omission
common Node/Bit-card internal redesign owned by P29-01 / D-CARD

directions: Before code, create a 2-theme by 9-surface element-level conformance map.
Classify each element as reproduce, preserve-and-blend, deferred owner, or user decision.
Separate the prototype-fidelity fixture from the production-preservation fixture.
Use prototype and production crops with identical data, state, and viewport.
Proceed as vertical slices: Shell/Pool/Context, then Breakdown/Staging, then Explorer, then interactions.
Do not advance to the next slice or full matrix before user visual disposition of the preceding slice.
Use approved semantic visual-structure component owners when CSS alone is insufficient.
Automation must not declare visual acceptance or Resolved.
Run the final dark/responsive/full-interaction matrix only after base composition approval.
